Players Committee card image of [[Commander Cody]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to same site as Obi-Wan. [Separatist] cards are power and defense value -1 here. When in battle at a site with Rex (or two of your clones), may cancel one just drawn battle destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/commandercody.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
